scope: ssm-scan.cu sm_80 PTX: 12 pre-existing kernels identical; 4 new kernels (ssm_ssd_init_state/pre_matmul/prepare_dt/...) plus new host dispatch for Mamba-2 prefill
build_config: nvcc 12.8 --ptx -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=compute_80 --extended-lambda -DGGML_BACKEND_BUILD, ggml/src + ggml/include of the respective revision

units.name: chunked SSD prefill pipeline
units.detail: new multi-kernel pipeline (red.global.add.f32 accumulation, ex2.approx, host-side dispatch and cuBLAS-style staging) replaces the single-kernel prefill path; no old kernel to pair it with and floating-point summation order differs

notes: The optimization is a new algorithm (chunked SSD matmul) selected by host code for large prefill; old and new paths are different multi-kernel computations, so no common harness/interface exists. Volta parses the new PTX; no semantic query was formed.
